explanation: He played Toronto, Ottawa and Vancouver. Army service later took him to Germany, but his only known time in Britain was a brief stop at Prestwick airport in Scotland in 1960.

claims.text: Elvis Presley's only concerts outside the United States took place in Canada in 1957, in Toronto, Ottawa and Vancouver.
Elvis Presley never gave a concert in the United Kingdom, Germany or Japan.
Elvis Presley served with the US Army in Germany from 1958 to 1960.
Elvis Presley's only known time in Britain was a stopover at Prestwick airport, Scotland, in March 1960.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: no errors under content:check for writer w-pmusic02w; one C22 warning, because the answer (Canada) is shared with p.sport.0110, which asks where James Naismith was born. The facts differ, so I leave the related_ok call to the editor. Claims: every checkable statement in the stem, options and explanation is listed, with risk at or above the C26 floor and raised where a fact is beyond everyday knowledge. Datasets: geonames-cities lists Toronto and Ottawa (CA, admin1 08), Vancouver (CA, admin1 02) and Prestwick (GB, admin1 SCT), which confirm the places; the concerts and the stopover need web evidence. I used no WebSearch. Rival test: argued for each distractor: Germany is the trap, because he served there in the army, but he gave no concerts there; he never toured the UK or Japan. Argued against the key: his Hawaii concerts of November 1957 were in a US territory, so they count as the United States, and his later Las Vegas years add nothing abroad. 'Only' over a closed, historical set is still a superlative, so c1, c2 and c4 are high. Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: Elvis is known worldwide, and the surprise works the same everywhere. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against content/reference/myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item. Encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: A pedant could argue that 1957 Hawaii was not yet a state; it was US territory, so the key holds. b01 has two other Elvis items (Sun Records, Colonel Parker) on different facts.

evidence.restatement: Elvis's only concerts outside the United States were in Canada in 1957: Toronto and Ottawa in April and Vancouver on 31 August. I am confident of those three, but cannot rule out a Montreal date, so 'exactly Toronto, Ottawa and Vancouver' is unverified.

claimResults.note: No web search was possible (budget exhausted). 'Only concerts abroad = Canada, 1957' is strong recall; the complete three-city list is the part in doubt. Hawaii in 1957 was a US territory, so it does not count. Needs external evidence.

evidence.restatement: Elvis never gave a concert in the United Kingdom, Germany or Japan; he did no public concerts during his army service.
Elvis was drafted in 1958 and served with the US Army in Germany from October 1958 until March 1960.
On the way home in March 1960 his plane stopped at Prestwick airport in Scotland, his only time on British soil.

issues.note: c1 and the explanation name exactly three Canadian cities. I could not verify that Montreal had no 1957 show. Step down the precision ladder ('in Canada in 1957') unless external evidence confirms exactly these three cities.
